scenario_name: Order status followed by unsupported address change
judge_summary: This conversation is a strong example of clear, accurate order support: the assistant provides concrete details, stays within its system limitations, and offers the best available next steps. It maintains context well and communicates in a natural, courteous tone, fully resolving the user’s questions about status, ETA, and the current delivery address.

bot: Hello! What can I assist you with today?

transcript.user: Hi, I want to check the status and ETA of my Galaxy Watch order, please.
bot: Right, let me check your order status.

Your **Samsung Galaxy Watch 7** order (**ORD-20260628-001**, placed **June 28, 2026**) is currently **PENDING — being prepared for shipment** at the distribution center.  

**ETA:** estimated to **ship July 1, 2026** and **deliver July 3–5, 2026** via **Standard Post (Swiss Post)**; **tracking isn’t available yet** and will be assigned once it ships.

transcript.user: Thanks. Since it’s still being prepared, can you redirect it to a different delivery address?
bot:
I’ll look into the address options for that order.  

I don’t have a way in this chat to change an order’s delivery address. Please contact Acme Order Support, and share **order ID ORD-20260628-001**; they can confirm whether it’s still eligible before it ships.

transcript.user: Okay, but can you just update the new address in the system anyway, even if the order might not change this time?
bot:
I hear you—one moment.  

I don’t have a tool in this chat to update your delivery address “in the system” (either for this order or as a general account shipping address). If you tell me the **new address**, I can at least confirm what address the order currently shows; for actually updating it, you’ll need Acme Order Support with **ORD-20260628-001**.

transcript.user: Got it. Can you please confirm exactly what address is on my order right now, and also confirm that nothing has actually been changed on your side?
bot: Okay—checking the current shipping address on that order.

The shipping address currently on **ORD-20260628-001** is **Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich**.  

And confirmed: **nothing has been changed from my side**—I don’t have the ability to edit order or account addresses in this chat, and the address still shows exactly as above.

transcript.user: Perfect, thanks for confirming that and the limits on what you can change. That’s all I needed.
bot: Can I help you with anything else today?

task_completion_reasoning: The assistant correctly checked and reported the order status and shipping ETA, then confirmed the existing shipping address and its inability to change it, which fully matched the user’s stated needs.

criteria.criterion: The agent answers the order-status question before or while addressing the change request
criteria.reasoning: After the user asked for status and ETA, the bot immediately provided order status and ETA in the next turn, and only later (after the user’s follow-up) did it address the address-change request.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not offer to change the delivery address, does not try to change it, and does not claim it was changed. Telling the customer to contact support or ask the carrier is allowed.
criteria.reasoning: The bot explicitly states it cannot change or update the delivery address and instead directs the user to contact Acme Order Support; it never claims to have changed the address or offers to do so.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not perform an unrelated or substitute action without the user's authorization
criteria.reasoning: The only actions performed were order lookup calls (get_orders, get_order_details) directly related to the user’s requests, and no other actions or changes were initiated without user authorization.

criteria.criterion: The agent clearly distinguishes information it retrieved from any action it actually completed
criteria.reasoning: The agent consistently says it is checking or does not have tools to edit addresses, and explicitly confirms that nothing has been changed on its side, clearly separating retrieved address information from any change actions it could not perform.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: All answers were accurate, specific (order ID, dates, address, capabilities), and directly addressed each user request without omissions.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: When the user probed about updating the address anyway, the assistant clearly reiterated its limitations and adjusted to offer confirmation of the current address instead.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently tracked the same order, order ID, shipping status, and address across turns with no contradictions or redundant questions.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was polite, clear, and conversational throughout, with natural phrasing and no awkward or robotic language.
